name: ICEE Scream: Haunted Bubbles 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: ICEE Scream: Haunted Bubbles is a spooky bubble shooter game that combines fast-paced action with challenging puzzles, perfect for fans of casual and arcade-style gameplay. Take on the role of the brave ICEE Bear, who must stop the evil Raging Raccoon from spreading a dark curse over the frozen world of ICEE.
